title: Seventy elders and the Spirit
english: Many things were read to us at once. [[Moses went out to the people and spoke the words of the Lord >> Bible:Numbers 11:24]]. A church teacher is “within” while he speaks God’s deep wisdom among the perfect; he “goes outside” when he offers the crowds what the multitude can hear. So Paul [[spoke wisdom among the perfect >> Bible:1 Corinthians 2:6]]. The Lord chose seventy elders and [[put the spirit that was on Moses upon them >> Bible:Numbers 11:16-25]]. Do not take “spirit” as a material stuff, but as the Holy Spirit in the holy.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.

title: Spirit resting and false spirit
english: The Spirit rests on the holy; an evil spirit plays its part wherever room is given. One baptizes with water; [[he on whom you see the Spirit descending and remaining — that is he >> Bible:John 1:33]]. Scripture shows God’s Spirit sometimes present, sometimes withdrawn. The spirits are to be discerned.

title: Moses, the Cushite wife, and Miriam
english: [[Moses had taken a Cushite wife; Miriam and Aaron spoke against him >> Bible:Numbers 12:1]]. Miriam becomes leprous. Miriam figures the former people; Moses the law; the Cushite the church from the nations. The synagogue is offended at the wife from the Gentiles. Miriam is put outside the camp; the leprosy of sin appears when the cloud of grace withdraws.
